===== prepare-semantic-supplement.py =====
"""Preserve complete material decisions and enumerate every raw input for review."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json

b = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
target = b / 'semantic-input-supplement.txt'
assert not target.exists()
selected = set(p for p in b.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.suffix in {'.md', '.json', '.diff', '.py'})
for folder in ('proposal-verification', 'root-reconciliation-verification'):
    selected.update(p for p in (b / folder).rglob('*') if p.is_file())
names = {
    'original-dispositions.json', 'final-decisions.json', 'errata-analysis.json',
    'unwrapped-extents.json', 'intended-spans.json', 'occurrences.json',
    'evidence-references.json', 'attempt-history.json', 'final-audit-addendum.json',
    'finalizer-execution-records.json', 'collection-proof.json',
    'proposed-span-head-allowances.json', 'pre-freeze-verification.json',
    'failed-source-capture-attempt01.json', 'physical-decode-failed-attempt.json',
    'input-proof.json', 'completion-input-proof.json', 'registered-class-check.json',
    'root-additional-query-reruns-full.json', 'original-replay-proof.json',
}
for angle in ('tibetan', 'english', 'reconciled'):
    for seq in (265, 266, 267):
        selected.update(p for p in (b / angle / str(seq)).iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name in names)
chunks = ['This supplement contains full material decisions and provenance. Root authored the Tibetan originals; its checks are mechanical, not independent semantic approval. The separate reviewer must independently read all original raw evidence enumerated in semantic-all-inputs.json, including historical versions and failed attempts. No final output is accepted yet.\n']
manifest = []
for p in sorted(selected):
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    chunks.extend(['\n===== '+str(p.relative_to(b))+' =====\n', raw.decode('utf-8')])
    manifest.append({'path': str(p.relative_to(b)), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
chunks.extend(['\n===== COMPLETE SUPPLEMENT MANIFEST =====\n', json.dumps(manifest, indent=2), '\n'])
target.write_text(''.join(chunks))
all_inputs = []
for p in sorted(b.rglob('*')):
    if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts and 'semantic-review' not in p.parts:
        raw = p.read_bytes()
        all_inputs.append({'path': str(p), 'relative_path': str(p.relative_to(b)), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
(b / 'semantic-all-inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(all_inputs, indent=2)+'\n')
result = {'supplement_bytes': target.stat().st_size, 'supplement_sha256': hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'complete_material_files': len(manifest), 'all_raw_input_files': len(all_inputs)}
(b / 'semantic-supplement-generation.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))

# Proposal-role capacity ruling for C05:265–267

Ruling: Because the platform retains only three available child records, use the primary Codex reader for the Tibetan-first original and reuse /root/c05_262_264_english for the English-first original. Reserve the two other child readers as non-authors for reconciliation and separate semantic review. Reusing both child authors would leave only one non-author for two review roles, so it would not preserve the required separation. This is an explicit departure from the SDD preference for fresh subagent authors and a controller-only primary; its workflow-constraint resolution permits a concrete continuation that keeps the user's independent proposal/review requirements.

The primary already prepared source/glossary leads for this future batch and must identify that as its own prior preparation, not claim a fresh or unprimed context. It has seen no English265–267 proposal because none exists yet. It must not open English proposal files, reports or judgments until its own Tibetan original freezes. The English reader must not open the primary's files or withheld root leads. Its completion message may give status/counts/hashes/paths only, without semantic findings, until both originals freeze. Detailed concerns belong in its private report; only mechanical access blockers should be raised early. Neither original author may serve as this batch's reconciler or separate semantic reviewer.

Cost if wrong: primary preparation may bias its Tibetan proposal, and combining author/controller roles reduces one extra independent root perspective. Mitigate with peer-output isolation, immutable full original evidence, explicit role labels, independently reopened source/canonical checks, and two distinct non-author reconciliation/semantic readers before acceptance. Do not claim fresh contexts or remove any fidelity/provenance/semantic gate. Any later correction to the Tibetan original must preserve its previous frozen evidence and receive the same independent review as the English original.

# Withheld root leads: C05:265–267

Preparation only. Do not expose these leads to either original-angle reader.

The first preparation attempt failed on a whole-file UTF-8 assumption; original
source/brief files survive unchanged. The successful check matches ASCII target
bytes against whitespace-normalized raw physical bytes, with no full-file
encoding inference or source alteration. Both attempts are recorded.

265 completes the three-part material-cause/contributing-factor account from
263–264. nyer len HGM5840 and lhan cig byed rkyen HGM21656 are separate causes;
the part supplies the former and the pleasure being's karma the latter. Preserve
the owners through the English syntactic reversal. HGM25288 rigs 'dra phyi ma
has later continuation and continuation; HGM18898 and11877 offer tighter members
only if exact two-sided subranges support them. skye ba HGM703 includes starts
being. Bound bdud rtsir must remain intact. Initial yang and final sogs retain
their separate discourse positions; final causal/copular framing may be
distributed, not a reason to manufacture an English word or null.

266 contrasts the glass having three parts with all three beings seeing all
three parts. Distinct gsum gas/gsum ga subject/object occurrences must not swap.
The first absent exact head gsum gas is an inflection, not absent evidence for
base gsum ga HGM21225 (all three/three/all three kinds/three types). The two
negative clauses have different positions: not the case vs doesn't see. Keep

but the English participant he is independently supplied. dbang gis HGM13091

de bzhin du HGM8502 includes the case is similar for, similar and related full
variants; shes par bya ba HGM20015 includes one should understand. Complete

267 contrasts a shared object of looking with the craving spirit's exclusive

# Independent semantic review: c5p89, C05:265–267

Read ../semantic-review-protocol.md first, then the worktree AGENTS, alignment

Codex producer roles supersede historical model names. This task has no permission

perform native/device/browser actions. Write only this batch's semantic-review/
directory. SQLite mode=ro and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 throughout.

Read every final reconciled spec/report/body, both original proposal angles and
all material original evidence. The accompanying semantic-input-review-package.txt
contains full source/spec context and proposal-to-reconciled diffs. Read that
whole package; root will not dispatch this review until it exists. Root's proofs
are mechanical evidence only. Check source fields, lexical attribution, occurrence
labels, omissions and every seven-depth correspondence independently.

Snapshot the original proposal inputs, including all superseded versions and
failed attempts, into semantic-review/proposal-inputs/. Keep complete current
individual specs/bodies/evidence under semantic-review/reviewed-final/<seq>/.
Include a manifest mapping each preserved original to its copy with hash and
byte count. Preserve source/witness bytes necessary to reproduce material claims.
The landing helper copies .json, .md, .html, .stderr, .stdout, .log, .txt, .bin and
.exit. Preserve other required input extensions as exact-byte .txt or .bin copies
with the original-to-copy mapping explicit (for example helper.py.txt). Do not
include Python caches. Do not silently overwrite historical evidence on re-review;
preserve the old copies and identify the new final hashes.

For every actual span, independently replay the canonical resolver and real
generator; compare exact complete output with the saved body. Produce the shared
protocol's exact seven-key resolved-spans.json in spec order. review.json must
contain verdict, open_findings, and a segments LIST for the current reviewed
files. For each segment record seq, span_count, null_count, word_pair_count
(non-null d5), spec_sha256, spec_bytes, body_sha256, body_bytes and generator_exit.
Use distinct SPEC and QUALITY verdicts in review.md. Approval is machine review,
not human editorial acceptance. If correction is needed, name exact span IDs and
minimal changes; do not edit the reconciler's files.

If a head allowance is needed, write span-head-allow-needed.json as a mapping:

bank-ready-errata.json, [] when none; every retained candidate needs independent
five-ground refutation, actual query/count proofs and complete physical original
witness files, with no publication/ingestion independence inferred from digital
identity. Preserve already registered classes and original source words.

No page has been accepted merely because a generator passes. Review all evidence
and current files before issuing APPROVE. Final reply: verdict, counts, open
findings, generator proof, errata result and report path; details stay on disk.

Mutable governing files may change when root registers preceding reviewed pages.
If you preserve any such file, record its original_git_commit and
repository_relative_path in the manifest, and prove the copied bytes equal that
Git object. Do not later compare a historical snapshot against a changed live
working file. Preserve all versions; root verifies copies before registration.
Include total_spans, total_nulls and total_word_pairs as well as per-segment data.

Use original-to-copy-manifest.json as a LIST of records with exact keys
original (absolute path), copy (relative to semantic-review), sha256 and bytes.

and repository_relative_path; copied bytes must equal that immutable Git object.
Preserve helpers with unsupported extensions as exact-byte .txt copies.
